# Third-party method mirrors

Local checkouts used by the aligned FDG→PSMA board:

- `SegAnyPET/` — SegAnyPET (ICCV'25)
- `DpDNet/` — DpDNet (MICCAI'25)
- `autoPET-V-BIRTH-final/` — BIRTH / hemingduo (AutoPET V'26)
- `autopet-v-yixinchen/` — YixinChen (AutoPET V'26)

Upstream licenses apply. A previous `seganypet_pip/` site-packages dump is **not** shipped; install dependencies via each project's requirements instead.
